source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record the:
    - Date and time,
    - Location of the building and the specific area within the building,
    - The specific standard or regulation that was not met,
    - Description of the condition or barrier found during the inspection,
    - Photos to illustrate the issue (include date and time stamp if possible).

3. Include details of the failed accessibility check in an organized format, such as:
```
Date: [Insert Date]
Time: [Insert Time]

Location: [Building Address, Name and Area (e.g., Entrance Lobby, 3rd floor restroom)]
Standard/Regulation Violation: [Specify exact standard/regulation]

Description:
- [Provide a detailed description of the accessibility issue, e.g., "Entrance ramp too steep, exceeding ADA’s maximum slope ratio of 1:12."]
- [Include measurements, if appropriate, e.g., "Slope measured at 1:10."]

Evidence/Documentation:
```
